ValidationRule.description: Prevent Broker set and office Group Changes on Duplicate Contact
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( INCLUDES(Sync_Status__c, 'Duplicate - Email'), INCLUDES(Sync_Status__c, 'Duplicate - OCV Id') ), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Broker_Set__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Broker_Set__c)) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Office_Group__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Office_Group__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact is a Duplicate, cannot Add Broker Set and Office Group
